svg.title: Glow weight profile
svg.desc: The quadratic falloff weight of a glow, the share of its blended weight inside a radius, and the literal pixels of a glow of radius 20.
svg.text: a glow is a quadratic falloff blended over the frame
Frame::halo and glow_fragment: w = strength (1 - d)^2, d = distance / radius
orange dot: half the blended weight lies inside d = 0.386
dashed: a linear cone, for comparison
radius 20: the box the CPU visits, and the pixels it blends
one hypot and one three-channel blend per blended pixel
Total blended weight is strength * pi R^2 / 6: a sixth of a flat disc of the same radius. The cost is the box,
between (2R + 1)^2 and (2R + 2)^2 visits, so doubling a glow's radius quadruples its CPU cost (VIEW_CONVENTIONS: cap glow radii).
